questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Which planet is closest to the Sun?

explanation.en: Mercury is the planet nearest the Sun, and also the smallest planet.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Mercury has no moons and no rings.

explanation.en: Mercury has no moons and no rings.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: About how many Earth days does Mercury take to orbit the Sun once?

explanation.en: Mercury is the fastest planet and completes an orbit every 88 Earth days.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Put these planets in order from nearest to farthest from the Sun.

explanation.en: Mercury is 1st, Venus 2nd, Earth 3rd and Mars 4th from the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Mercury is the hottest planet in our solar system.

explanation.en: Venus is hotter. Mercury is closer to the Sun but has almost no atmosphere to trap heat.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: What does Mercury have instead of a thick atmosphere?

explanation.en: Mercury has a thin exosphere made of atoms knocked off its surface, not a real atmosphere.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Match each Mercury time to its length.

explanation.en: Mercury spins slowly, so one solar day (176 days) lasts two of its years.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Put these planets in order from smallest to largest.

explanation.en: Mercury is the smallest planet, then Mars (7th largest), Venus (6th) and Earth (5th).

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: About how much of Mercury's radius is taken up by its iron core?

explanation.en: Mercury's metallic core is about 85% of the planet's radius.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Mercury is the second densest planet, after Earth.

explanation.en: Its huge iron core makes Mercury the second densest planet, after Earth.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Match each Mercury fact to its number.

explanation.en: Caloris is a giant impact basin; Mercury is small, fast, and 0.4 AU from the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Order these temperatures from hottest to coldest.

explanation.en: Venus reaches about 467 C. Mercury's day hits 430 C but its night drops to -180 C.
